name: QUIC Network Simulator
description: Test framework for benchmarking QUIC implementations under various network conditions. Uses ns-3 for network simulation with Docker containers isolating client, server, and simulator components.

docker_support.docker_evidence: The framework uses docker-compose to compose three docker images: the network simulator, and a client and a server.

eval_notes: Well-structured Docker-based simulation framework with ns-3 as the network backbone. Three-container architecture (client/server/simulator) is a clean pattern for protocol testing evaluations. Could be adapted for other protocol testing scenarios.
